name: io.github.acertijosapps/electron-viewer
title: Electron Viewer
description: Drive Electron apps over CDP: screenshots, clicks, drags, keys, JS in renderer and main, logs.

environmentVariables.name: ELECTRON_VIEWER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Viewer to show actions live (default http://localhost:8094); without it, CDP is used directly

environmentVariables.name: ELECTRON_VIEWER_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Electron project folder that launch_app starts with `electron .` (default: the current folder)
